## Change and reason

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the reviewed submission issue for new projects.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `node --check app.js` and `node --check schema.js`.
- [ ] Ran `node --test tests/catalog.test.mjs`.
- [ ] Ran `node scripts/validate-projects.mjs --check-links` and reviewed inconclusive results.
- [ ] Confirmed public source, license, ownership, attribution, and actual release asset URLs for any added project.
- [ ] Checked the UI at mobile and desktop widths for UI changes.

No submission is automatically approved or merged.
